# FilePilot Copilot Instructions

## Commit Tracker Requirement

- For any task that includes creating one or more Git commits, update `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md` in the same work.
- Add exactly one new entry per commit at the top of the `## Commit Entries` section.
- Include date, short hash (or `pending` before commit), commit subject, implemented scope, and affected areas.
- If a commit is completed with `pending`, replace it with the actual short hash before finishing the task.
- Do not create a commit without a corresponding tracker entry.
